setupObservationExpired: The setup deadline has passed. Its final status could not be confirmed. You can start again.
configurationInvalidOnebot: Check the connection settings. OneBot requires a numeric self ID and an IP-based listener address with a valid port.
title: Integrations
description: Connect accounts once, then choose which apps can use them.
unavailable: The integration service is unavailable. Check Nimi and try again.
connectionSetupHelp: After connecting, choose which apps can use this connection in App permissions.
weixinStepGenerate: Select the button below to generate a connection QR code
weixinStepScan: Scan it in WeChat and follow the prompts to confirm
name: Connection name
feishuNamePlaceholder: Give this connection a name, e.g. Work Feishu
custody: Nimi Runtime keeps credentials. Allowed apps receive a connection reference and the results of their permitted operations.
telegramMode: Reply collection uses one shared receiver. Existing webhooks must be managed at their source; this form does not remove them.
connected: Connected. Close this window and open App permissions to authorize apps and operations.
allowApps: Allow apps to use an integration
permissionHelp: One choice permits these operations during normal and background use. You can revoke an app independently.
narrowBody: After saving, the operations below are no longer allowed. Their calls in progress are interrupted, and a write already sent may have taken effect.
removeBody: Every app's permission for it is revoked, calls in progress are interrupted (a write already sent may have taken effect), and its stored credential is removed from Nimi. Existing call records are kept. This can't be undone.
removed: Connection deleted and its permissions revoked.
providerOffline: The providing app is offline. Its description is available; calls will fail until it is running.
verificationRequired: Verify this bot's identity to keep using the existing connection. Permissions and the reply position will be retained.
verified: Connection verified. Existing permissions and reply position are retained.
allowed: The selected permissions have been saved.
empty: Connect a service or run an app that provides an integration.
identifierCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the identifier above to copy it manually.
unavailablePermissionConsumer: New permissions are unavailable for this instance. Existing permissions can still be revoked.
unavailablePermissionSource: The source is currently unavailable. Its permissions are retained.
revokeBody: This app will no longer be able to use the current {{service}} connection.
revokeBodyGeneric: This app will no longer be able to use the corresponding connection.
noPermissions: No apps have been allowed yet.
recordsHelp: Up to 100 recent calls. Call facts are retained for at most 30 days; credentials and private content are omitted.
unknownAttribution: Name not recorded at the time
homeBody: Connect accounts, allow apps and review recent use.

errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_RESPONSE_INVALID: WeChat returned a response Nimi could not verify. The operation stopped. Check the connection before starting a read again; check the original result before repeating a send. If it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_UPDATES_INVALID: WeChat returned an unreadable message list. Receiving stopped; check the connection before starting again. If it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics.
errors.INTEGRATION_SETUP_LIMIT: Four setups are already active. Complete or cancel one, then start again.
errors.INTEGRATION_SETUP_EXPIRED: This setup expired. Start a new setup.
errors.INTEGRATION_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED: The platform token or session expired. Authenticate the same identity again to refresh it.
errors.INTEGRATION_RATE_LIMITED: The platform rate limit rejected this request. Wait before starting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_NETWORK_FAILED: The platform connection failed. Check the network and start again.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_REQUEST_FAILED: The Feishu request failed. Check the network and application credentials.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_PROVIDER_REJECTED: Feishu rejected this request. Check credentials, bot publication and required application permissions.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_REGISTRATION_REJECTED: Feishu application registration could not continue. No connection was created. Retry; if it still fails, check the network or confirm that the tenant permits application creation.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_REGISTRATION_DENIED: Application registration was not authorized. No connection was created. Start again if needed and confirm authorization in Feishu.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_REGISTRATION_INVALID: Nimi could not verify the Feishu registration response. No connection was created. Check the connection and start again; if it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_IDENTITY_INVALID: Feishu did not return a verified bot identity. Enable and publish the bot, then try again.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_QR_INVALID: WeChat did not return a usable verification code. Start again.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_QR_REJECTED: WeChat declined or expired this verification. Start again.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_PROVIDER_REJECTED: WeChat rejected this request. Check the selected account and verification state.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_IDENTITY_INVALID: WeChat did not return a verified account identity. Authenticate again.
errors.INTEGRATION_MANAGEMENT_DENIED: This connection does not have Nimi Home management access.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_CONFLICT: This bot already uses a webhook. Select a dedicated test bot or manage its receiver at the source.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_BOT_ALREADY_CONNECT: This bot already has a connection. Select it from the existing integrations and allow the apps that need it.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_VERIFICATION_REQUIR: Select this connection and verify the bot's identity first.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_IDENTITY_INVALID: Telegram did not return a valid bot identity. Check the credential and try again.
errors.INTEGRATION_NEW_TARGET_REQUIRED: Create a new connection for a different account or service.
errors.INTEGRATION_IDENTITY_ALREADY_CONNECTED: This bot or account is already connected. Use its existing connection, or remove it in the Nimi account that owns it before adding it again.
errors.INTEGRATION_PROVIDER_REJECTED: The service rejected this configuration. Check the account details.
errors.INTEGRATION_DISCOVERY_FAILED: The service did not provide a usable operation catalog.
errors.INTEGRATION_ENDPOINT_INVALID: Enter a valid HTTPS MCP service address.
errors.INTEGRATION_ADAPTER_NOT_READY: This adapter is not ready in the current Runtime build.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT: The protocol end did not establish a verified API connection in time. Check its reverse WebSocket address, token, self_id and role, then start again.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_VERSION_INVALID: The protocol end did not identify its implementation and OneBot v11 version.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_BUSY: This connection is in use. Stop reception and pending sends before verifying again.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_IMPLEMENTATION_CHANGE: The selected implementation or version changed. Verify this connection again.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_LISTENER_BUSY: This listener address is already occupied. Stop active reception or sends before verifying again, or choose a free local port.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_AUTH_REQUIRED: Enter the same nonempty access token configured in the protocol end.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_LISTENER_LIMIT: Too many OneBot listeners are active. Stop an unused operation before starting another.
errors.INTEGRATION_QQ_GATEWAY_INVALID: QQ did not provide a usable official WebSocket gateway.
errors.INTEGRATION_QQ_AUTH_REJECTED: QQ application verification did not complete. Check the App ID, current App Secret and QQ platform status, then verify again.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_IDENTITY_INVALID: The actual bot account does not match the configured numeric self_id.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_TRANSPORT_PROTECTION_: This build admits local loopback OneBot connections. A remote listener requires actual transport protection before use.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE: The Feishu request is too large after UTF-8 encoding and JSON escaping (text: 150 KiB; card: 30 KiB). Shorten it and send.
errors.INTEGRATION_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: The connection settings are invalid. Check the selected service and its required fields, then start again.
errors.INTEGRATION_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED: This connection changed during verification. Refresh the connection list, check the current settings and start verification again.
errors.INTEGRATION_INPUT_INVALID: Check the connection name and required fields before starting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: The selected connection no longer exists. Refresh the connection list and select a current connection.
errors.INTEGRATION_SCOPE_ENDED: The current account session ended. Sign in again and start verification.
errors.INTEGRATION_SETUP_STOPPED: This setup stopped. Start a new setup if needed.
errors.INTEGRATION_QQ_SECRET_REQUIRED: Enter the current QQ App Secret for this App ID.
errors.INTEGRATION_QQ_REQUEST_REJECTED: QQ rejected this request. Check the bot settings and required platform permissions before starting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_QQ_RESPONSE_INVALID: QQ returned a response Nimi could not verify. Check QQ platform status and the connection; if it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics. Confirm any original write result before repeating it.
errors.INTEGRATION_QQ_RESPONSE_UNCONFIRMED: The QQ request result could not be confirmed. Check the original result before repeating a write.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_SETUP_REQUIRED: Choose a Feishu connection method and provide its required application details.
errors.INTEGRATION_FEISHU_RESPONSE_INVALID: Feishu returned a response Nimi could not verify. Check Feishu platform status and the connection; if it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics. Confirm any original write result before repeating it.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_DISCONNECTED: The protocol end disconnected. Check its connection before starting new work; an old message will not resend automatically.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_ROLE_INVALID: The protocol end did not provide the required API and event roles. Check its reverse WebSocket configuration.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_REQUEST_REJECTED: The OneBot protocol end rejected this request. Check its configuration and supported operations.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_RESPONSE_INVALID: The OneBot protocol end returned an unreadable response. Check its implementation and configuration; if it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics. Confirm any original write result before repeating it.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_RESPONSE_UNCONFIRMED: The OneBot request result could not be confirmed. Check the original result before repeating a write.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_RESULT_UNCONFIRMED: The OneBot operation result is unconfirmed. Check the original result before repeating a write.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_FRAME_INVALID: The protocol end sent an invalid OneBot frame. Check its implementation and configuration before starting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_ONEBOT_FRAME_BOUNDS: The protocol end sent a OneBot frame beyond the supported size. Reduce its payload before starting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_SETUP_REQUIRED: Scan in WeChat to verify this connection before using it.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_CREDENTIAL_INVALID: The WeChat verification did not provide a usable credential. Scan again.
errors.INTEGRATION_WEIXIN_ENDPOINT_INVALID: The WeChat verification returned an unsupported service address. Check the connection before scanning again. If it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics.
errors.INTEGRATION_TELEGRAM_CONFIGURATION_INVAL: Check the Telegram bot settings before starting verification again.
errors.INTEGRATION_SCHEMA_INVALID: The service provided an invalid operation description. Correct its description before connecting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_OPERATIONS_BOUNDS: The service's operation catalog exceeds the supported limits. Reduce it before connecting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_RECEIVER_DRAINING: Reception is still stopping. Wait for it to finish before starting new work.
errors.INTEGRATION_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE: Nimi could not record this operation. Check Runtime diagnostics before starting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: This connection is unavailable. Refresh the connection list and check its current state.
errors.INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE: The integration service is unavailable. Check Runtime diagnostics before starting again.
errors.INTEGRATION_TIMEOUT: The request timed out. Check the connection; confirm any original write result before repeating it.
errors.INTEGRATION_CANCELED: The operation was canceled. Start new work if needed.
errors.INTEGRATION_REQUEST_INVALID: The request could not be prepared. Check its input and connection settings.
errors.INTEGRATION_RESPONSE_INVALID: The service returned a response Nimi could not verify. Check the service and connection; if it keeps failing, check Runtime diagnostics. Confirm any original write result before repeating it.
errors.INTEGRATION_EXECUTOR_FAILED: The operation did not complete. Check Runtime diagnostics and resolve the problem before starting again.

feishuCreate: Create an app with an official QR code
cancelFailed: Cancellation did not complete. Please try again.
cancelNotCompleted: The connection status changed and was not canceled. Check the current result.

setupStates.completed: Connection ready. Choose App permissions below.
setupStates.awaiting-new-target: WeChat returned a new bot. Confirm whether to create a new connection.

refreshIdentityHelp: Re-enter the original App ID, or OneBot self ID and listener, with the new credential. Nimi verifies the same identity and configuration and retains this connection and its app permissions. Stop existing operations first; a different identity or configuration requires a new connection.
verificationInvalid: Enter the nonempty numeric verification code shown in WeChat.
feishuManualHelp: In the Feishu developer console, enable the bot, select long-connection event delivery, add the Receive message event, then grant the app permissions below and publish. No user permissions are needed.
qqMode: Enable the official QQ bot WebSocket subscription for C2C and group messages in the QQ developer console. Apps can reply or send using a current received-message context; active pushing without context is refused. QQ credentials and OneBot connections are independent.
onebotMode: Use an already selected OneBot v11 protocol end on this computer. Enter its numeric bot account and a matching nonempty access token. Nimi verifies the actual account and implementation version; it does not install the protocol end.
onebotProtocolHelp: Configure authenticated reverse WebSocket at ws://<listener>/ with Authorization: Bearer <token>, matching X-Self-ID, and Universal or paired API/Event roles. Keep the protocol end reconnecting while verification, reception or a send is active; Runtime closes the listener when that work ends. Stop reception and pending sends before refreshing credentials. Non-loopback use requires transport protection. Technical reconnect never resends an old message. Standard images use owned bytes up to 4 MiB; files require verification of the selected implementation and version.
alreadyBound: The original connection is already bound. No credentials were updated; existing permissions are unchanged. Previous operations will not retry automatically.
newTargetConfirmation: WeChat confirmed a new bot identity. Confirm to create a separate connection. The original connection, history, and permissions are preserved; apps need fresh permission for the new connection.
newConnectionCreated: New connection created. Select apps and operations to grant fresh permission.
weixinRefreshHelp: Scan with the original WeChat account. If WeChat returns a new bot, confirm a separate connection and grant App permissions again; the original connection stays unchanged.
selectExistingTarget: Select an existing connection to manage its permissions.

operationSummaries.send: Send one message to the specified conversation using this account.
operationSummaries.send_weixin: Send once to a peer using a current received-message context for that peer.
operationSummaries.send_qq: Send once using a recent message context for the same recipient: C2C within 60 minutes, group within 5 minutes, sharing at most 5 replies per source message.
operationSummaries.reply: Reply once to the message referenced by Runtime. The provider must still accept that reference.
operationSummaries.update: Change the text or card of an existing Feishu message.
operationSummaries.receive: Read all new messages on this connection. Conversation filters select a view; they do not restrict the granted permission.
operationSummaries.media: Download referenced received media into the invoking app’s own asset storage.

filteredRecordsHelp: Latest 100 calls · Kept up to 30 days · No credentials or private bodies
unknownCallError: This operation did not complete. Check the error code, calling app, and connection status.
unconfirmedHelp: The result is unconfirmed. Check the original outcome before sending or writing again.
noMatchingCalls: No calls match the current filters.
noEligibleApps: No apps are currently available to authorize. You can still view or revoke existing authorizations in the list.
authorizeAppsHelp: Choose apps to use “{{connection}}” and select the operations they may perform.
editPermissionsHelp: Adjust the operations this app may perform using “{{connection}}”.
allAppsAuthorized: All currently eligible apps are already authorized for this connection. There is no need to add them again.
editExistingPermissionsHelp: To adjust permissions, close this window and choose Edit permissions in the authorized apps list.
removeSummary: Remove this connection when you no longer need it. Apps using it will lose access.
checkConnectionHelp: Check that the service is running and the network is connected, then check the status again.
refreshSummary: Use when credentials change or authentication is needed. No routine updates are required.
stopOperationsHelp: Before starting, stop receiving and pending sends in apps using this connection. Find them under App permissions.
reconnectHelp: If authentication is needed, reconnect the original account. For other issues, check the service and network first.
appProviderHelp: Run an app that provides an integration to inspect its operations and allow other apps to use them.
batchPermissionHelp: Select one or more apps. Saving replaces each selected app’s permissions with the checked operations below; unselected apps are unchanged.
unlistedOperations: Previously allowed operations missing from the current catalog
unlistedOperationsHelp: These operations remain in existing permissions. Keep them checked to preserve them, or uncheck and save to withdraw them.
closeSetupHelp: Closing this window cancels the unfinished connection setup.
affectedApps: Permissions for these apps will also be revoked
